column1: Aggressive wasteland raider armed with a trench shotgun. Rapid close-range shrapnel bursts; uses Adrenaline sprint.
column2: 凶悍的荒原突袭步兵，装备战壕霰弹枪，近距离快速发射破片弹幕，并可使用肾上腺素冲刺。

column1: Armed scrapper with a 20 mm defensive cannon. Harvest fields, construct buildings and recover 35% of a ground machine’s material cost from its wreck within 3 minutes. Dismantle wrecks into materials on-site.
column2: 装备20毫米自卫机炮的拾荒工程车。采集资源、建造设施，并在残骸消失前的3分钟内回收地面机械35%的材料造价。可在前线直接拆解残骸获取材料。

column1: Armored bulk hauler. Collect eight materials per load, construct and repair structures; self-repairs when idle.
column2: 重装散货运输车。每次运输8单位材料，可建造、维修建筑，空闲时自动修复。

column1: Camp exclusive. Heavy ballistic shield breacher with a close-range combat shotgun. Activate Shield Wall for 40% damage resistance and suppression immunity.
column2: 佣兵营地专属。装备近战霰弹枪的重型持盾突击兵，可开启盾墙获得40%伤害减免并免疫压制。

column1: Camp exclusive. Long-range heavy breach rockets against armor and structures. Launch Disruptor Rocket to damage, drain shields, and slow hostile vehicles.
column2: 佣兵营地专属。使用远程重型破障火箭攻击装甲和建筑；可发射干扰火箭造成伤害、抽取护盾并减速敌方车辆。

column1: Camp exclusive. Reconnaissance marksman with 18 m vision and heavy sniper rifle. Launch Spotter Flare to illuminate fog and mark targets for 20% increased damage.
column2: 佣兵营地专属。视野18米的侦察射手，装备重型狙击步枪；侦察照明弹可照亮战争迷雾并标记目标，使其受到的伤害提高20%。

column1: Dedicated air defense that prioritizes aircraft. Ground damage: 33% Uses 1 power.
column2: 专用防空设施，优先攻击航空单位。对地伤害为33%，耗电1。

column1: Energy disruptor soldier firing guided ion torpedoes to penetrate vehicle armor and overload electronics.
column2: 发射制导离子鱼雷的能量干扰步兵，可穿透车辆装甲并使电子系统过载。

column1: Fast cybernetic operator with rapid plasma carbine. High mobility makes it ideal for capturing relays and flanking.
column2: 装备速射等离子卡宾枪的高速义体作战员。机动性强，适合夺取中继站和侧翼突袭。

column1: Fast guerrilla infantry against infantry and light machines. Capture relays; recover at a ranger camp. Weak against armor.
column2: 擅长对抗步兵和轻型机械的快速游击步兵。可夺取中继站，并在游骑兵营地恢复；对重装甲较弱。

column1: Fast wheeled technical with twin autocannons. Flank enemy armor and screen lines.
column2: 装备双联自动机炮的快速轮式武装车，适合包抄敌方装甲并掩护战线。

column1: Fixed ground cannon; protect against infantry and aircraft. Uses 1 power.
column2: 固定式地面火炮，防御步兵和航空单位，耗电1。

column1: Forward materials drop-off. Build near ore to shorten Mule Hauler delivery routes.
column2: 前线材料卸载站。建在矿区附近可缩短骡式运输车的往返路线。

column1: Forward refinery
column2: 前线精炼站

column1: Frontier tracker with a heavy scoped hunting rifle. Long-range precision fire against infantry.
column2: 装备重型瞄准猎枪的边境追踪者，擅长远程精准打击步兵。

column1: Heavy frontline armor with thick composite plating and a 105 mm cannon. Serves as the durable anchor of your ground forces.
column2: 配备厚重复合装甲与105毫米火炮的重型前线战车，是地面部队可靠的防御支点。

column1: High-energy shocktrooper armed with twin pulse repeaters. Relentless close-quarters energy fire and rapid sprint.
column2: 装备双联脉冲连射器的高能突击兵，提供持续的近距离能量火力，并可快速冲刺。

column1: High-speed repulsor hover skimmer armed with rapid twin pulse lasers. Uses superior mobility to flank and outrange heavy armor.
column2: 装备速射双联脉冲激光器的高速反重力掠行车，以优异机动性迂回包抄重装甲。

column1: Missile air defense that prioritizes aircraft. Ground damage: 33% Uses 2 power.
column2: 导弹防空设施，优先攻击航空单位。对地伤害为33%，耗电2。

column1: Mobile anti-tank hunter armed with scavenged heavy RPGs to break enemy armor. Fires Guided Salvo rockets.
column2: 装备回收重型反坦克火箭的机动猎坦步兵，可发射制导齐射火箭击破敌方装甲。

column1: Phase Shift teleports 8 m in a chosen direction every 15 seconds. Precision: 12 m anti-armor lance, 0.75 s charge; weak against infantry. Interception: full air damage, 33% ground damage. Switching disables fire for 2 s.
column2: 相位跃迁可沿指定方向瞬移8米，冷却15秒。精准模式：射程12米的反装甲长矛，充能0.75秒，对步兵较弱。拦截模式：对空全额伤害、对地33%伤害。切换模式会停火2秒。

column1: Produces Flux Skimmers, receives harvested resources and supplies 8 power.
column2: 生产通量掠行车、接收采集资源，并提供8电力。

column1: Produces Mule Haulers. Receives harvested resources. Supplies 8 power.
column2: 生产骡式运输车，接收采集资源，并提供8电力。

column1: Trains militia in triplets and specialists in pairs, plus a unique hero. Two infantry recovery slots within 5 m. Uses 2 power.
column2: 成组三名训练民兵、成对训练专业步兵，并可训练独特英雄。5米内提供两个步兵恢复位置，耗电2。

column1: Unarmed Flux Skimmer: hover across rough ground and gather electronics 25% faster. Reach a foundation to deploy a nanite beacon, then return to gathering while the building assembles itself.
column2: 无武装通量掠行车，可悬浮越过崎岖地面，电子资源采集速度提高25%。抵达地基部署纳米建造信标后即可返回采集，建筑将自行组装完成。

column1: Unique faction hero. One alive or in training per player; can retrain after death. Requires a command lab.
column2: 阵营独特英雄。每名玩家最多拥有一名存活或训练中的英雄，阵亡后可以重新训练；需要指挥实验室。

column1: Unlocks Battle Rigs without Coordination. Repairs ground machines. Uses 2 power.
column2: 无需协同作战科技即可解锁战斗平台，并可维修地面机械，耗电2。

column1: With a robotics foundry, unlocks Lancers and Wraiths. Research Coordination for Prism Skimmers. Uses 5 power.
column2: 配合机械铸造厂解锁长矛机甲和幽灵炮艇。研究协同作战科技后可生产棱镜掠行车，耗电5。

column1: With a vehicle factory, unlocks combat walkers and strike aircraft. Research Coordination for Siege Colossi. Uses 5 power.
column2: 配合车辆工厂解锁战斗机甲和突击航空单位。研究协同作战科技后可生产攻城巨像，耗电5。
